module.name: no-sinon-imprecise-spy-assertions
module.description: Require explicit count and numbered-call argument checks in Sinon assert calls.

scenarios.name: should allow explicit call counts and zero calls
should allow arguments for a numbered invocation
scenarios.when: the rule inspects the first argument

scenarios.name: should allow exact single-call arguments
scenarios.when: the rule checks the method name

scenarios.name: should ignore unrelated or shadowed assert objects
scenarios.given: assert comes from another package or a Sinon import is shadowed

scenarios.name: should report called without an exact count
scenarios.given: sinon.assert.called receives a spy or one of its numbered calls

scenarios.name: should report calledWith variants on a whole spy
scenarios.given: calledWith, calledWithExactly, or calledWithMatch receives the whole spy

scenarios.name: should report getCall without an index
scenarios.given: calledWithExactly receives spy.getCall() with no index
scenarios.when: the rule checks the first argument

scenarios.name: should report argument matchers without a spy argument
scenarios.when: the rule checks the first argument

scenarios.name: should report aliased and computed Sinon assertions
scenarios.given: a default, namespace, or named Sinon import uses a computed assertion member
